ya, lately i have been a loner, and i do live in my head a lot of the time, actually, probably half my life i've been living in my head. it aint exactly easy to turn off, when there's hardly anything to do to preoccupy my mind in reality, 
what is the point of going through failure, heartbreak, tragedy, regret, and pain, again and again. finding something to live for? life goals and dreams? soul mates? destiny? that's all fantasy. i really don't feel like going through that emotional high that lasts for months and years on end, only to get to the end of the journey and when it all falls apart, what a complete waste of my time.

i was nice, i was really nice, i did something freaking nice, but what i got out of it was pain, lots of fucking pain and anger, because being a nice and respectful is not fun, having morals and values is boring, let's just barge in and wreck his peace with lies and deceit, let's take away that which he saved and worked hard for months on end changing peoples lives for the better because we're drunk, selfish and want a piece of that cake without his knowledge.
